headline: Bank of Japan Expected to Keep Rates Steady While Upgrading Inflation Forecasts
summary: The Bank of Japan plans to slightly upgrade its fiscal year inflation forecasts while keeping interest rates stable at 1.25% during its upcoming policy meeting.
why: Central bank policy guidance and inflation revisions set borrowing costs and guide foreign exchange valuation for the world's major economies.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Upgraded inflation forecasts alongside steady interest rates maintain prevailing monetary conditions in Japan.
